      Travel to Italy

      Experience the Timeless Charm and Elegance of Italy with Saudia Airlines

      Immerse yourself in a land where every cobblestone tells a story and every meal is a celebration. From the rolling hills of Tuscany to the historic grandeur of Rome, Italy invites you to rediscover the joy of living. Fly with Saudia to begin your Italian journey with signature hospitality and modern comfort.


      1. Master The Art Of Pasta Making

      Step into a traditional kitchen to learn the secrets of the sfoglina. Knead fresh dough and shape delicate fettuccine or ravioli by hand for an authentic taste of Italian heritage.


      2. Join A Guided Truffle Hunt

      Follow expert hunters and their loyal dogs through secret woodlands. Experience the thrill of unearthing rare treasures and enjoy the earthy aromas of the forest.


      3. Tour Sun-Drenched Vineyards

      Stroll through rows of vines in the heart of the countryside. Discover the meticulous craft behind world-renowned labels and enjoy tastings overlooking golden, rolling landscapes.


      4. Savor Authentic Neapolitan Pizza

      Visit the birthplace of pizza for a slice of culinary perfection. Watch masters toss dough before it enters a wood-fired oven to emerge with a signature charred crust.


      5. Explore Bustling Local Markets

      Wake up your senses in vibrant piazzas filled with fresh produce. Chat with local vendors while selecting sun-ripened tomatoes, artisanal meats, and regional specialties.


      6. Learn Traditional Cheese Crafting

      Visit a local dairy to see how iconic cheeses are made. Gain a new appreciation for the aging process and the delicate balance of flavors in every wheel.


      7. Discover Ancient Roman Ruins

      Walk through history at the Colosseum and the Roman Forum. Stand where gladiators once stood and marvel at the architectural feats that shaped western civilization.


      8. Experience Coastal Boat Tours

      Sail along the dramatic cliffs of the Amalfi Coast or the sparkling waters of Capri. Feel the Mediterranean breeze as you discover hidden sea caves and colorful harbors.


      9. Join An Olive Harvest

      Participate in a centuries-old tradition in the olive groves. Learn how liquid gold is pressed and taste the vibrant, peppery notes of the season’s freshest oil.


      10. Taste Aged Balsamic Vinegar

      Visit an acetaia in Modena to witness the patience required for true craftsmanship. Sample complex, syrupy glazes that have been aged to perfection in wooden barrels.

      Scroll to view more →

      Cities You Should Visit When Traveling to Italy

      1. Rome

      Step into the Eternal City, where the past and present dance together. Explore the mighty Colosseum, toss a coin into the Trevi Fountain, and savor authentic gelato while wandering through sun-drenched piazzas. Rome is a living museum that fuels your soul with its unrivaled history, divine flavors, and vibrant energy.


      2. Milan

      Experience the heartbeat of Italian style in Milan. Admire the gothic grandeur of the Duomo, witness the genius of Leonardo da Vinci's Last Supper, and shop the world’s most iconic fashion houses. This sleek metropolis blends high-end design with timeless culture, offering a sophisticated escape for every traveler.
